narrative.intro: Battelle Memorial Institute has $1.5B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. The vendor recorded 1 award so far in the fiscal year and the average award size is $1.5B. Obligations are down 11.4% year over year. Historical obligations show $1.3B in FY21, $1.5B in FY22, $1.6B in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, $1.6B in FY25, and $1.5B in FY26. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity, while the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values rather than obligations. This record indicates that FY2026 activity to date equals $1.5B, matching FY22 but below the $1.6B reported in FY23 through FY25, and that the program of work so far is concentrated into a single award with a reported average award size of $1.5B.
